description: PAID ($0.001 USDC via x402). Where a token earns the most, from DefiLlama's yield index: pools filtered by chain (default Base; "all" for every chain), token symbol (USDC, ETH, cbBTC…), stablecoin-only and a minimum TVL (default $1M), sorted by APY or TVL — each with total, base (fees/interest) and reward APY, the 30-day mean, 7-day change, IL risk, exposure and a DefiLlama link. Statistical outliers are excluded unless includeOutliers is true. Data, not financial advice. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

chain.description: Chain as DefiLlama names it (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Solana, …), default Base; "all" for every chain

includeOutliers.description: Include pools DefiLlama flags as statistical outliers (default false)

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

sort.description: Order: apy (highest first, default) or tvl

stablecoinOnly.description: Only pools DefiLlama classifies as stablecoin pools (default false)

symbol.description: Only pools holding this token symbol (e.g. USDC, ETH, cbBTC)

name: defi_yields

asOf.description: ISO time the yield index was read

matched.description: Pools that matched before the limit

note.description: How the APY figures are built, and their limits

pools.description: The pools, ordered by the requested sort

title: Best DeFi yields by chain and token (DefiLlama) ($0.001)
